QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Alliance of Two Worlds
QuestInfo.0: After the festival ends, talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Heliseum has been reclaimed, but the true enemy still remains. It's not about Magnus now, but #rGerand Darmoor#k. 

The Nova want to ally with the Maple Alliance to prepare for future conflicts. Go to the Conference Room of the Alliance with Edea.
QuestInfo.2: The alliance of two worlds has become a reality.
